title: Midday Amber Bright

diffuser.notes: Run 20–30 min during the midday slump; refresh after lunch.

spray_optional.note: Shake well before each spray; mist into air, not on skin.

why_it_works: Sparkling mandarin and lemony litsea lift the spirit, while a whisper of warm cardamom adds cozy autumn grounding.
safety: Avoid eyes/mucosa; keep from children & pets.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or under care.
